_comment: Failures that are the control working, not a broken pipeline. A failed run counts as 'blocked by design' when EVERY failed job carries at least one failure annotation matching one of these patterns (title equal, message matched as a case-insensitive regex). Such runs never open a ci-failure issue; the digest lists them separately. A crashed scanner ('scanner failed ...', 'failed without producing a report') does not match, so it is still reported.

patterns.title: Secret gate
patterns.why: Gitleaks found secrets and the default-blocking secret gate stopped the build

patterns.title: Image gate
patterns.why: Defender found critical image vulnerabilities and the image gate stopped the publish
